newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks open lower as engineering scrips fall.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks open lower as engineering scrips fall.

text.p: Dhaka stocks opened lower on Saturday as a market correction, which emerged following sharp gains in the past week, pulled down the engineering scrips, brokers said.
The market was closed on Thursday for a public holiday and on Friday for the Moslem weekend.
Brokers said prices of several other stocks were set to fall amid a selling pressure by investors booking profit.

Olympic Industries fell 175 taka to 3,291 and Bangladesh Lamp shed 520 to 9,913. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index fell 233.20 points or 6.39 percent at 3,415.54 on Wednesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
